title: A Sunny Day at the Park
passage: It is a sunny day. Amy and Ben go to the park. They see a green tree and a red bird. They are happy.

title: Breakfast for My Family
passage: My family eats breakfast in the kitchen. Dad has an egg and some toast. Mom drinks tea. My sister and I share an apple. We put the dishes on the table when we finish.

title: The Little Dog Goes to School
passage: Milo is a little dog who lives near a school. Every morning, he watches the children carry their books and bags. One rainy day, a boy drops his blue notebook by the gate. Milo picks it up and waits there. After class, the boy finds Milo with the notebook. He smiles and says, “Thank you, my good friend!”
